title: 第3章 考验身心第4章 长春经
content_zh:
;;
枫林子带着三个小孩不过走了一个时辰的路，天就暗下来了。
这时前不着村后不着店的，他们只能露宿野外了。
一行人匆匆忙忙在野外过了个难捱的夜晚，第二天一早就再次上路。
只是，行至中午，他们绕过一处山坳之后豁然开朗。
只见郁郁葱葱的林原之中有一条山涧分割两边。
而在山涧上游，一座巍峨道宫横跨两边！
那山涧赫然就是从道宫下的石道中奔涌出来的。
“这就到了？”
苏白尘有些傻眼，这么快就到了吗？
他飞快看了眼枫林子，总感觉昨天下午出发，就是为了让他们在外面过夜吃个苦而已。
枫林子一把按住了苏白尘的脑袋道：“别胡思乱想了，你们只是通过了我的选拔，进入山门以后可还要通过诸位长老的选拔才能够成为正式弟子。”
苏白尘问：“如果选拔不通过呢？”
另外两人也都露出了关切之色。
枫林子正色道：“不通过，那也只能由我再送你们回去了。”
“但那可是一件非常丢人的事情，不是吗？”
苏白尘一下沉默，他也有些紧张了。
而枫林子看着他们道：“现在，你们的任务是在这林原中找到到达长春宫的路径。长春宫就在那里，你们……好好表现。”
苏白尘看了眼那似乎并不遥远的长春宫，心里面也知道这里肯定没有那么简单。
而当枫林子宣布他们可以自由行动的时候，那王行远立刻冲了出去。

他好像很急躁，急于表现自己，所以直接沿着山涧想要往上爬。
然而只是爬了两步他就脸色大变。
因为这条看起来最近的路果然不简单，他感受到巨大的压力压迫在身上，每前进一点都要耗费不少的力气。
苏白尘看他走了一段路就开始冒汗、喘气，就知道这条路不简单了。
他想了一下，看向旁边的森林，问林招娣：“林姐姐，要一起走吗？”
林招娣立刻点点头，她没什么主见，就跟着苏白尘一起走进了林原……
林原中也有路，这是一条狭窄的小道，蜿蜒着往山上而去。
“娃！”
忽然，苏白尘的耳边传来了这一世母亲的呼唤。
那已经是他六岁前的记忆了，哪怕过了这么久，再次听到时他还是浑身一个激灵，心中有些起伏。
他惊愕地四下张望，忽然看到旁边出现了另一条岔道，那道路延伸入山林中，在岔路上，他记忆中的母亲以一种更年轻的姿态出现在了他的面前，在那向他招手。
再往岔道深处去看，隐隐约约可以看到村庄房屋的轮廓……好像那苏家村啊。
苏白尘微微错愕，心里面只觉得眼前之物如同虚幻泡影，没有给他带来一丝一毫的真实感。
他摇摇头，知道这必然又是一种考验了。
于是在稍稍停顿之后，就一路往前继续前进。
content_en:
;;
Feng Linzi and his three children had only walked for an hour when it started to get dark.
At this time, they had no choice but to sleep in the open air.
The group of people hurriedly spent an uncomfortable night in the wild and hit the road again early the next morning.
However, at noon, after they rounded a mountain col, it suddenly became clear.
I saw a mountain stream dividing the two sides of the lush forest.
And in the upper reaches of the mountain stream, a towering Taoist palace spans both sides!
The mountain stream apparently rushed out from the stone path under the Dao Palace.
"We're here now?"
Su Baichen was a little dumbfounded, had he arrived so soon?
He quickly glanced at Feng Linzi and felt that he set out yesterday afternoon just to make them suffer while spending the night outside.
Feng Linzi held down Su Baichen's head and said, "Stop thinking nonsense. You have only passed my selection. After entering the mountain gate, you will have to pass the selection of the elders before you can become a formal disciple."
Su Baichen asked: "What if I don't pass the selection?"
The other two people also showed concern.
Feng Linzi said seriously: "If you don't pass, then I can only send you back."
"But that's a very shameful thing, isn't it?"
Su Baichen was silent for a moment, and he became a little nervous.
Feng Linzi looked at them and said: "Now, your task is to find the path to the Changchun Palace in this forest. The Changchun Palace is right there, you... behave well."
Su Baichen glanced at Changchun Palace, which seemed not far away, and knew in his heart that it was definitely not that simple here.
When Feng Linzi announced that they could move freely, Wang Xingyuan immediately rushed out.
He seemed to be impatient and eager to express himself, so he went straight up the mountain stream to climb up.
However, after just two steps, his expression changed drastically.
Because this road that seemed to be the shortest was indeed not easy, he felt huge pressure on his body, and it took a lot of effort to move forward.
Su Baichen saw that he started to sweat and pant after walking for a while, and he knew that this road was not easy.
He thought for a moment, looked at the forest next to him, and asked Lin Zhaodi: "Sister Lin, do you want to go together?"
Lin Zhaodi nodded immediately. She had no idea and followed Su Baichen into Linyuan...
There is also a road in the forest. It is a narrow path that winds up the mountain.
"Baby!"
Suddenly, Su Baichen's ears heard the call of his mother in this life.
That was a memory he had before he was six years old. Even after so long, when he heard it again, he still felt excited and felt a little ups and downs in his heart.
He looked around in shock, and suddenly saw another fork in the road, which extended into the forest. On the fork, the mother he remembered appeared in front of him in a younger appearance, waving to him.
Looking deeper into the fork in the road, you can vaguely see the outline of the village houses... It looks like Sujia Village.
Su Baichen was slightly stunned. In his heart, he only felt that the things in front of him were like illusions and bubbles, which did not bring him any sense of reality.
He shook his head, knowing that this must be another test.
So after a brief pause, we continued moving forward.
